title: Evaluate Gemma 3n E4B-it (IQ4_XS) as researcher brain vs Qwen3-4B
notes: RESOLVED: keep Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. License: Gemma outputs are unencumbered (Sec 3.3 disclaims rights) = compliant-with-caveats, but the terms are use-restricted + Google-updatable, not Apache-class. Capability: Qwen dominates for THIS pipeline: MMLU-Pro 69.6 vs 50.6, IFEval 83.4 vs unpublished, native hermes tool-calling vs generic fallback, 262k vs 32k ctx. Deal-breaker: llama.cpp issue #14698 = Gemma 3n fails to LOAD on AMD Vulkan (oversized per-layer-embedding buffer allocation), exactly our backend. Gemma wins only conversational prose polish. Could revisit as a prose-flavor A/B after NVIDIA upgrade.
